question:
**Direction: Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Backstab
solution:
The correct answer is **"Betray."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Backstab" **means betrayal (as by a verbal attack against one not present) especially by a false friend. (विश्वासघात (जैसे कि किसी गैर-मौजूद व्यक्ति के विरुद्ध मौखिक हमला) विशेष रूप से किसी झूठे मित्र द्वारा)

 
 
• **Example**: *He accused his boss of dirty tricks and **backstabbing**__.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms for **betray**: deceive, double-cross, sell out, stab in the back.
 
• **"Betray"** means to be disloyal or unfaithful, especially to a friend or someone who trusts you. (शत्रु को गोपनीय मामलों की जानकारी देना; रहस्‍य उजागर करना)
 __
 
• **Example:** *He felt **betrayed**__ by his own brother when he found out he had been stealing money from him.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bleary** means tired or blurred vision. ((आँखें) लाल, थकी हुई और धुँधली दृष्टि वाली)
 
• **Berate** means to scold or criticize someone angrily. (क्रोधपूर्वक किसी को डाँटना या आलोचना करना)
 
• **Blare **means to make a loud, harsh sound. (ऊँची कर्कश ध्वनि उत्‍पन्‍न करना)
